conditions: Production field_lab::fixture and Brain; temporary categorical lateral odor cue_currents adapter and Chamber positive turn gain8 and distance coefficient .012. Brains warm60 unstimulated ticks at stationary initial pose(-2,0), heading0; then300 moving chamber ticks. Fields settle100 ticks before observation. Sources ahead at(-.75,-.75) and(-.75,+.75), before the partition wall. All source scenes use background brightness .2. No-current controls clear external current each step. Only odor scenarios are run; uniform controls equal no-current controls. Baseline fields omit source: wind0 and source fields cannot affect the body except through disabled neural injection. Bilateral ablation begins after warmup, includes original groups even where stimulus excludes readouts. All comparisons paired by seed.
experimentalMapping: Odor only categorical lateral detection: when max(L,R)>=0.05 and abs(L-R)>0.05*(L+R), inject fixed1 into greater-side pathway and0 into other side; otherwise both0. Only local sensory magnitudes are consulted. Production side identity/readout exclusion are unchanged; body decoder uses positive turn gain8 and distance coefficient .012 instead of .12.
metrics: turn/flightTurn are mean motor outputs. headingTowardSource is source-side signed net heading change; positive means yaw toward the initial source side. distanceReduction is actual initial distance minus final source distance. minimumDistanceReduction uses minimum observed distance including initial pose. earlyHeadingIntegralTowardSource integrates unwrapped yaw toward initial source side over first60ticks (6seconds); earlyAlignmentTowardSource averages actual target-facing cosine over first60ticks. All source-relative metrics consume the fixture source_position owner. finalAlignmentTowardSource is final heading dot normalized vector to source, positive means facing toward it. Difference metrics subtract the matched control. leftMinusRight uses the negative-Z source minus the positive-Z source; its spatial metrics are each oriented toward their own source.
uncertainty: Student t(9)95% intervals across paired seed means, descriptive without multiplicity correction. Free movement changes subsequent sensory histories; this is a finite closed-loop fixture, not proof of biological preference or asymptotic target seeking.
postprocessing: The three prespecified trajectory metrics were recorded in seedObservations during simulation but omitted from the summary name list. They were summarized afterward with the same sample mean, sample SD and Student t(9)95% formula; no simulator rerun or trajectory modification.
reproduction: Restore experimentalSourceSnapshots to their crate files, then cargo run -p sim --release --example field_probe -- GRAPH_DIRECTORY OUTPUT_JSON. Supplement the three trajectory summaries as described in postprocessing. Original files restored after experiment.
